# Upsampler

> > Upsampler is an all-in-one AI platform for image generation, upscaling, restoration, and video creation with free tools and developer APIs.

Upsampler provides both web-based tools and REST APIs for AI-powered image and video processing. The platform integrates multiple state-of-the-art models including Stable Diffusion, Flux 2 Max, and proprietary models, serving both casual users and developers with flexible subscription and credit-based pricing.

## Key Topics

- Image Upscaling
- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- AI Tools
- REST API
- Stable Diffusion
- Flux 2 Max
- Free Tools
- No Sign-Up
- Credits System
- Subscription Plans
- Webhook Integration
- Super Resolution
- Image Restoration
- Video Enhancement
